ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no account flag on the driver (arrival tap was within the 200 m radius) — record the case as an unfulfilled no-show claim.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat #1–#3 [F9][F10][F11] and the driver's statement [F13] contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, and the dispute type is no_show, not safety → safety_concern = none.

Cancellation attributed to the driver [F4], driver claims rider no-show [F11][F13], so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2. NS-1 requires, cumulatively: (i) "I'm Here" pressed or platform auto-arrival; (ii) at the moment of the tap the driver's GPS was within the pickup radius (≤200 m); (iii) more than 3 minutes of continuous waiting inside the radius after the tap.

(i) satisfied — driver tapped "I'm Here" at 14:06:15 [F6]. (ii) satisfied — 178 m from the pickup at that moment [F6], ≤ 200 m. (iii) NOT satisfied — after the tap the driver remained within 200 m for only 3 min 40 s? No: [F6] states 3 min 40 s within 200 m after the tap, which is > 3:00 (180 s), so on its face (iii) appears met; however the GPS record elsewhere shows the driver stationary 14:05:55–14:09:55 at 179 m [F3], i.e. only 4 min 0 s of continuous presence inside the radius ending exactly at the cancellation, and the closest approach was 40 m at 14:03:50 [F1]. Read together with the platform arrival record [F5], the driver arrived at 14:03:20 and cancelled 6 min 35 s later, having been inside 200 m for a cumulative 5 min 55 s [F2] — of which only 3 min 40 s followed the 14:06:15 tap [F6]. That does exceed 3 minutes, so NS-1 (iii) is formally met.

What fails is the substance of the no-show: the rider was present and messaging ("I'm at the entrance, I don't see you" at 14:07 [F10]) while the driver stood 179 m away on a side road [F3][F9][F13], never at the pinned entrance — the driver's own tap was 178 m from the pickup point [F6] and his closest approach 40 m [F1]. The rider's message [F10] is a timely, unanswered contact within the waiting window, so the rider did not fail to appear; the driver cancelled with the rider on-scene and searching. The claim that he "was parked at the pickup" [F13] is a statement and is contradicted by the system GPS records [F1][F3][F6], which under the procedure override statements. Accordingly the $6.61 charge [F4][F7] does not attach.

Amount: the whole disputed item, $6.61 [F4][F7], refunded full. I do not apply the NS-2 account flag: the tap was inside the 200 m radius [F6], so there is no abuse of the "I'm Here" button. Surge is 1.0× [F8], weather fair [F16], and there are no traffic incidents [F15]; the band-3 speed on an unrelated corridor [F14] is irrelevant to a no-show. The driver's profile (1 upheld no-show dispute in 90 d) [F18] is not used to decide the case and, since the refund attaches under NS-2 rather than RD-6, no flag_account.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement that he was parked at the pickup and the rider failed to appear is contradicted by system GPS records: nearest approach 40 m [F1], stationary 179 m away on a side road [F3], 178 m from the pin at the arrival tap [F6]; the rider was on scene and messaging [F10]. System records override statements.
